name: Shrimp Pasta Bento with Arugula and Marinated Egg
personality: I'm a sophisticated multitasker who brings together land and sea with effortless elegance. Balanced and refined, I believe every bite should tell a story of harmony and wholesome goodness.

speeches.text: With **28g of protein** flowing through me, I'm basically your personal muscle architect! Those gorgeous shrimp and silky egg team up to rebuild you stronger after every workout.
My **45g of carbs** from these golden noodles are your premium fuel tank. I'll keep your brain sharp and your energy steady all afternoon long.
I carry **12g of healthy fat** that helps your body absorb all the good stuff. Think of me as your nutrient delivery service with style.
My **420mg of potassium** keeps your heart rhythm smooth like jazz. Those shrimp aren't just pretty—they're working overtime for your muscles.
That peppery arugula gives me **3g of fiber** to keep things moving along nicely. Greens aren't just garnish, darling—they're essential.
The arugula sneaks in **12mg of vitamin C** to boost your immune system. I'm full of little surprises like that!
With **85mg of calcium** from my leafy greens and egg, I'm quietly strengthening your bones while you enjoy every delicious bite.
